UNLEASHING FIRE — the dragon pours a torrent of flame down onto the battlements, stone exploding and defenders scattering as the inferno washes over them.
STRAFING THE ARMY — the dragon skims low over the ranks, a river of flame trailing from its jaws, soldiers diving and banners igniting in its wake.
CLASHING MIDAIR — the dragon collides with a rival, jaws locked on its throat, both tumbling through the sky wreathed in fire and torn wing-membrane.
DIVING TALONS-FIRST — the dragon plummets onto the watchtower, claws punching through stone as the structure collapses inward, dust and masonry erupting in all directions.
SEIZING THE CATAPULT — the dragon snatches the war machine in its claws, splinters flying as the siege engine crumples, its crew hurled across the field.
SMASHING THE WALL — the dragon swings its tail in a crushing arc, a section of curtain wall detonating outward, rubble cascading over the soldiers massed below.
REARING TO FIRE — the dragon rises onto its haunches and looses a fireball that detonates against the gate, ironwood and iron bolts blasting apart in a gout of orange ruin.
BITING DOWN — the dragon clamps its jaws around a knight in full plate, steel crumpling like parchment, the man vanishing between teeth as the army recoils in horror.
LANDING AMID SOLDIERS — the dragon crashes into the formation, the shockwave of its impact throwing men outward in every direction, spears shattering beneath its chest.
BUFFETING DEFENDERS — the dragon beats its wings against the parapet, the concussive blast hurling soldiers off the wall's edge, shields spinning away into the darkness below.
BREATHING FROST — the dragon exhales a cone of ice across the charging cavalry, horses and riders freezing mid-gallop, the whole formation shattering as it strikes the ground.
ROARING WREATHED IN FLAME — the dragon opens its jaws in a thunderous roar, fire rolling off its scales, the sound alone cracking the gatehouse lintel and breaking the front rank.
RAKING THE RAMPARTS — the dragon drags its talons along the wall-walk, stone peeling away in long furrows, defenders tumbling into the courtyard in cascades of torn masonry.
COILING AROUND THE TOWER — the dragon wraps its body around the keep and constricts, the stonework buckling and groaning before the entire spire collapses in a grinding avalanche of debris.
SLAMMING ITS SKULL — the dragon headbutts the gatehouse arch at full speed, the impact detonating stone outward, the portcullis launching across the courtyard like a thrown spear.
HURLING A BOULDER — the dragon scoops a catapult stone mid-flight and flings it back, the projectile punching through the siege tower's hull and sending it toppling in flames.
TORCHING THE FLEET — the dragon sweeps low across the harbor, a sustained jet of fire igniting sails, pitch, and hull-timber, masts toppling as the ships become floating pyres.
PINNING A WARBEAST — the dragon drives an enemy war-elephant into the earth with one forelimb, the ground cratering on impact, the beast flattened beneath the crushing weight.
SPIRALING WITH A RIVAL — the two dragons corkscrew downward locked together, tearing at each other with talon and fang, the air around them shredding into smoke and blood-mist.
EXHALING ACID — the dragon vents a stream of corrosive breath across the armored column, steel dissolving and men screaming as the caustic cloud rolls over the entire vanguard.
SWEEPING ITS WING — the dragon brings one wing down like a scythe across the bridge, the span cracking at its center, soldiers plunging into the gorge amid twisted timber.
TORCHING THE SIEGE TOWERS — the dragon banks hard and breathes along the line of wooden towers, each one catching and roaring upward, the screams of those inside swallowed by flame.
CRASHING THROUGH THE PALISADE — the dragon shoulders through the outer wall at a dead charge, logs and stakes exploding outward, the entire defensive line folding as if made of straw.
SNATCHING THE COMMANDER — the dragon drops from altitude and seizes the general from horseback, lifting him skyward as his escort scatters and the army's formation dissolves in panic.

DROPPING FROM THE CLOUDS — the dragon falls silent and vertically from an overcast sky, striking the command tent dead-center, the explosion of canvas and broken earth swallowing the whole war council.
